material_corrections: Pilipovsky et al. 2023 is directly relevant published deep-ReLU CF/Hilbert propagation literature omitted by original R335.
Explicit 2^n orthant/mask enumeration is not proved necessary for every exact representation.
The 2^n mask count is an explicit-representation output-size observation, not a general algorithmic lower bound.
A single Gaussian/orthant-type query must not be labeled inherently exponential.
